title: Fire: smoke over the openings
problem_line: Smoke drifts over two sides of the house. What can the camera honestly say about the openings?

beats.caption: Smoke drifts north-east over sides B and C.
Openings under smoke read 'unclear': the option to say anything else is removed by code.
When the smoke thins, the occupant outside side C is detected.

success_line: Nothing declared safe; the occupant found when the camera could actually see.
